description: A tight bedside vignette in a sophisticated hotel-style bedroom. The headboard wall is split vertically — the left portion features a large-format upholstered panel headboard in a soft grey-beige linen fabric with subtle seam detailing creating a grid of wide rectangular panels, while the right portion is clad in a rich dark walnut veneer with a fine straight grain. The walnut panel section functions as the integrated nightstand wall. A single-drawer bedside table in matching dark walnut with a simple brushed metal pull sits flush against the walnut wall panel below. On the nightstand surface, a black desk-style telephone and a small black device sit cleanly. Above the nightstand, a matte black rectangular electrical outlet-and-USB panel is recessed flush into the walnut veneer. A warm amber glow emanates upward and downward from a brass wall-mounted reading source, casting a focused warm spot on the walnut panel and a downward pool of warm light on the nightstand surface below. The bed is dressed in crisp white hotel-quality sateen duvet and multiple white pillow layers. The atmosphere is quiet, luxurious, and minimal — a modern hotel vernacular. Camera is at seated to standing eye-level, tight vignette composition capturing the right half of the headboard, the nightstand, and the wall panel zone above it. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category. Render the fixture exactly per the reference image — preserve all proportions, materials, finishes, and design details.
